title: Chapter 835 There Is No Loyal Minister In The World
content:
Chapter 835 There Is No Loyal Minister In The World

"When I usually have free time, the Prime Minister doesn't come, but he chooses to pick me to come to see me when I am free and happy. The beauty is in front of me. Is this bullying me?"

In late December of the first year of the Second Emperor's reign, at Zhangtai Palace in Xianyang, after Prime Minister Li Si took his leave, the Second Emperor Hu Hai put away his smile and became furious!

Just now, when he wanted to have fun with three beauties, the doctor's order, Zhao Gao, came to report that Li Si requested an audience, and the boss was immediately unhappy.

Hu Hai has been living in the palace for several months. On the one hand, there are gangs of thieves and rebels running rampant outside, and he has lost news about counties and counties. He is in panic all the time, but he does not have the ability and determination to clean up the country. He can only rely on I numbed myself with women and alcohol, trying to tell myself:

"Anyway, there is Wang Ben outside, and Li Si and Zhao Gao inside. A small rebellion, but the sky will not fall."

On the other hand, it was because of Zhao Gao's persuasion.

"The Emperor is a noble person, but because he is heard, the ministers are not allowed to see his face, so he calls himself 'I'. Moreover, Your Majesty is still very young and may not understand everything. Now that he is in charge of the government, he is faced with those complicated documents. If the rewards and punishments are slightly inappropriate, your shortcomings will be exposed to the officials, and you will not be able to show your Majesty’s wisdom to the people of the world."

"What's more, the magicians and witches have said that if the master lives and the ministers know about it, it will harm the gods. Your Majesty might as well imitate the First Emperor and live deep in the palace, so that the ministers do not know where to do it, and the officials receive decisions. I will report it to Xianyang Palace, and when they report the official affairs, I will present it to His Majesty with the practitioners in my service, so that he can make a decision."

"In this way, Your Majesty will be able to rule with dignity, and at the same time, your Majesty will be able to make the ministers feel that Your Majesty is a Holy Lord like the First Emperor. He is unpredictable and cannot be deceived!"

This was originally a ploy by Zhao Gao to seize power, but Hu Hai trusted Zhao Gao so much that he believed his lies and began to imitate Qin Shihuang's behavior in his later years. He no longer went to court, but lived deep in the palace, enjoying the pleasures of wine pools and meat forests. He was happy to be an ostrich with his head buried in the sand, leaving all military and state affairs to Zhao Gao, who held the jade seal, to make decisions.

For a time, Xianyang seemed to be divided into inner and outer dynasties. In the inner dynasty, there were Hu Hai's cronies headed by Zhao Gao, but the prime minister, the imperial censor, and Jiu Qing could hardly see Hu Hai's face.

Wang Ben and Feng Quji were away from home and could not care about the affairs of the court. Although Li Si was in Xianyang, this old fox was not a direct minister. In difficult times, "bearing each other for the sake of the country", and not wanting to offend Hu Hai, actually went along with his wishes and did not raise any objections.

But as the "Feng Jie surrendered to the enemy" case broke out in early December, Feng Quji's family was arrested and imprisoned. The elderly Feng Quji was even brutally tortured. The government and the public were in an uproar. Li Si could no longer sit still and repeatedly requested Meet Hu Hai.

But Zhao Gao got into trouble and groveled in front of Li Si and volunteered to inform him. On the other hand, he always took advantage of Hu Hai's sexual ambitions to lure Li Si into the palace.

Hu Hai suppressed his anger and met with Li Si, and listened to the white-haired old man's long explanation of the doubts about "Feng Jie's surrender to the black".

Li Si said that this might be Heifu's counterintuitive plan to cause civil strife in Xianyang!

Hu Hai had already made up his mind, so he was quite impatient. If Zhao Gao hadn't winked from the side, he would have almost gotten angry on the spot!

After Li Si left, he immediately threw a copper lamp stand and cursed:

"Feng Jie surrendered to the gangsters. The evidence is conclusive. Not only did the remaining soldiers flee to Hanzhong to report what they saw that day, but Feng Jie also scolded me for being in an unfair position and called on the people in Guanzhong to respond. What else is there to say?"

Qin Law: "If a general with more than a thousand people goes to the north in battle, defends and surrenders, flees from the ground, he is ordered to be called a national thief. He kills his family members, removes their residence, and finds their tombs. Their bones are exposed in the market, and their men and women are exposed to the public." official."

Zhao Gao is a master of law and order, his son is a national thief, and his whole family is implicated. This is the reason why Lang Wei arrested Feng Quji. No one can find fault. The only question is whether Feng Jie's story is true.

But Zhao Gao was not busy with the investigation. Instead, he ordered his son-in-law Yan Le to list Feng Quji with a bigger crime: "Failure to fulfill orders, relying on bullying, exploiting thieves with rice, allowing the enemy to advance, and stopping troops." If there is no fight, reinforcements will be gathered four times and all will be dismissed, and the thieves will be thinned to Wuguan."

Hu Hai was brainwashed by him and believed it without any doubt:

He gritted his teeth and said: "This old thief Feng Quji, as a front-line supervisor, only knows how to ask for food from Guanzhong, but all of it is for the enemy! The black thief's subordinate Han Xin has traveled thousands of miles with more than 10,000 people. He is in Nanyang With tens of thousands of troops, there was nothing they could do to defeat the rebels. They sat back and watched as they destroyed counties and captured towns, burned hundreds of thousands of grains and grains, and set off beacon fires in Wuguan and Hanzhong. This was the shame of the Qin Dynasty. It was said that this was not intentional. , I don’t even believe it! If Marquis Tongwu hadn’t withdrawn his troops in time and returned to defense, then Han Xin would probably have entered the pass."

"Knowing this, Li Si repeatedly advised me to handle this case with caution..."

Hu Hai frowned, feeling that things were not that simple.

He was startled, turned around suddenly, with a look of shock on his face, and asked Zhao Gao in a low voice: "Mr. Zhongling, Li Si, might he be like Feng, and want to betray me? You know, that black man, he is Li's master." The person who supported him, his son Li You, was also captured by Hei Ze!"

This conjecture was extremely bold, and Zhao Gao was also shocked. Although he wanted to seize power and isolate himself from the inside and outside, he also understood that Li Si and Wang Ben could not move!

The fall of the Feng family will not affect the overall situation, but if the two pillars of Li and Wang also fall, then Hei Fu may really break in and chop off Zhao Gao's head!

He then solemnly said: "How can your Majesty doubt Prime Minister Li? The late emperor selected two ministers for your Majesty's auxiliary affairs. There are two Feng surnames, and the others are Li Si and Wang Ben. Now Feng Wuze has lost his master and humiliated the country. Feng Quji and his son Feng Jie was guilty of surrendering to the enemy, so he assisted the government with important ministers, leaving only Wang Ben outside and Li Si inside. Prime Minister Li had served as an official in the Qin Dynasty for forty years. He was not only an important minister of the late emperor, but also his Majesty's support for maintaining the world. Don’t be suspicious!”

But once Hu Hai's idea came up, it was like a seed sprouting and taking root in his mind. Ever since the governor of Shu County rebelled against Qin and defected to Hei, Hu Hai was hit hard. Everyone thought it was Hei Fu's inside job.

For example, six months ago, Baba sent 20 million yuan to the imperial court for emergency relief, and Hu Hai was overjoyed to make Wu Shiluo the Marquis of Guannei. Didn't he also hide his traitor and betray the Qin Dynasty?

He doubted everyone.

Except Zhao Gao.

"Fortunately, I still have Lang Zhongling."

Hu Hai stood up, held Zhao Gao's hands, and regarded the master who had taught him since childhood as a life-saving straw:

"As Lang Zhongling said, I have to rely on Li Si and Wang Ben, but they still don't understand me. Only Lang Zhongling understands me!"

"Is the person I want to kill Feng Quji?"

Hu Hai gritted his teeth and revealed his real purpose: "What I really want to kill is Feng's son-in-law. He seems to be obedient, but in fact he has evil intentions and ambitions. He is the greatest threat to me, Young Master Gao!"

…

After Li Si left the palace, he went straight to the official office of Tingwei.

During the large-scale arrests of gangsters in the past few months, Xianyang Prison was already overcrowded, the city was full of prisoners, and ministers looked at each other. However, the place where Li Si came was only dedicated to imprisoning serious criminals from the imperial court. Not only were the brothers Meng Tian and Meng Yi , there are also uncles and nephews Feng Quji and Feng Jing.

As a former court captain, Li Si was no stranger to this place. He covered his mouth and nose with a brocade handkerchief, but he could still smell the smell of blood and feces. He was led by the jailer all the way to the end, opened the heavy door, and stood in In this dark prison, Li Si saw his old friend who had worked with him for decades...

Feng Quji lay on the straw in a daze. Although there was no rule in the Qin Dynasty against punishing doctors, Feng Quji was the Prime Minister of Zuo after all, and Yan Le, who was presiding over the case, did not dare to attack him.

The jailer shouted: "Feng Jun, Prime Minister Li is here to see you!"

Feng Quji stood up, looked at the tables, wine and food placed in the narrow prison, and said with a wry smile: "Is Tonggu here to see me off?"

Li Si knelt down on the straw mat and poured a glass of wine for Feng Quji: "It's too early to tell. Your case has not yet been concluded."

Feng Quji held the case and said: "Throughout the ages, although my son is a mediocre general, based on my understanding of him, he would rather die in battle than surrender to the enemy. I have never had any intention of treason. I am not guilty." !”

"Go away the disease, you have eight sins."

But Li Si did not mention the eight items listed by Zhao Gao and others, and only smiled and said: "You have been governing the people for more than forty years as an official of the Qin Dynasty. When the First Emperor first came to the throne, you and I were appointed as Langguan. We will ask each other day and night, and the king and his ministers will be in charge." Yes, this is a crime."

"Before the unification, as a guest minister, I served as an adviser in the outer world, and used the money and jade to alienate the princes. You served as the censor inside, doing your best to obey the law. Together with the internal and external forces, we finally threatened Han and weakened Wei, and defeated Yan, Zhao, and The Yi, Qi, and Chu conquered the six kingdoms and captured their kings, so that the First Emperor would eventually become the Son of Heaven. This was two crimes."

"After the unification, I was the imperial officer and you were the royal censor. We both made plans for the First Emperor. We abolished feudalism, established prefectures and counties, established communities, built ancestral temples, and enabled the Qin Dynasty to reform the bad governance of the previous generation. This is three crimes."

"After we both became prime ministers, we lost and lost the laws and regulations, fought against dendrobium and measured articles, and spread them throughout the world in order to establish the name of Qin. This is the fourth crime."

"Governing Chidao, promoting tourism and tourism, and following the First Emperor to tour the nine states to see the Lord's satisfaction, these are the five crimes."

"Unfortunately, the First Emperor passed away. You and I are the auxiliary ministers appointed by the late emperor. We supported my successor to the throne. We discussed suspended sentences and punishments, and reduced taxes and taxes in order to appease the people of the world. This is the sixth crime."

"It coincides with the rebellion of Heifu and the restoration of the Six Kingdoms. You were ordered to go east to Nanyang in the crisis and serve as the supervised army for the Marquis of Tongwu. You transported grain and grain as if walking on thin ice. This is a seven-year-old crime."

"In order to repay the kindness of the late emperor and for the great Qin State, you have been busy for forty years, and you were still writing memorials until the night before you were arrested. You have worked really hard. This is the eighth crime..."

Li Si bowed his head to Feng Qu and said, "These are the eight major sins of Mr. Feng that I stated in front of Your Majesty!"

"Only Tonggu still remembers it."

Feng Quji was a little touched and burst into tears: "Tonggu understands me, Tonggu believes in me."

"Of course I believe you."

Li Si said with emotion: "Everyone in the world knows that Feng Qujiruo also secretly plotted rebellion..."

"Then there will be no more loyal ministers in this world!"

…

After a while, after drinking a few cups of wine, Li Si comforted Feng Quji and said before leaving: "As long as Li Si is here, the jailer will not dare to touch Mr. Feng. Please wait with peace of mind. Si will do his best to rescue Mr. Feng!"

Feng Quji believed it without any doubt.

When Li Si left the prison of Tingwei's official office and got on the carriage, his second son Li Yu, who had just followed him in, asked in a low voice:

"Father really wants to save Feng Quji?"

"save him?"

Li Si closed his eyes slightly, but there was a trace of sarcasm on the corner of his mouth.

"I entered the palace today to test His Majesty. He sent Feng Quji to prison. The person who really wants to implicate and put him to death is Young Master Gao!"

"Your Majesty has made up his mind to kill his brother and Feng. Now, I am afraid that even Li Si is under his suspicion. I am too busy taking care of myself that I have no time to save others!?"

…
